name: Native click-to-move obstacle discrimination
purpose: Determine whether one game-issued destination causes obstacle-aware routing, and retain the route/collision leads for REA.
environment: RIFT-Lab VMware guest; exact current process/session binding required at execution

reuse.playerTelemetry: observation.readback player coordinates, qualified through existing guest readiness checks
reuse.selectedTarget: observation.readback.typedApi.snapshot.target, entity and per-field status must be ok
reuse.mouseTransportLimitation: Existing UI-only helper prohibits game movement; reuse transport through the supervised gameplay flow only after that action is implemented and authorized.

prerequisites: Fresh reviewed in-world screenshot with text entry closed; preserve existing 45-second review and 1.5-second pre-input freshness gates.
Advancing source sample, exact guest process/build identity, no unresolved pending input.
A supervised one-click gameplay action with mouse-up recovery and accurate gameInputSent reporting.
Explicit live-input approval required by RiftReader AGENTS.md; autonomy does not override its stated live-input gate.
Demonstrate actual in-game cancellation before an obstacle trial; controller pause, mouse-up, key-up and process timeout alone are not cancellation evidence.

trials.name: Clear-ground activation and cancellation
trials.goal: A nearby visible ground destination in an uncluttered area
trials.stimulus: One reviewed ground click using the actual Rift movement gesture, then the explicitly approved candidate cancel action
trials.observe: Record advancing XYZ before click, during movement and after cancel; require position stability after cancel

trials.name: Clear-ground destination baseline
trials.goal: Nearby visible ground point on the same surface
trials.stimulus: One game-issued destination; no re-aim, W step, route injection or custom detour
trials.observe: Record arrival, movement activation, elapsed time and any endpoint mismatch

trials.name: Wall with an accessible opening
trials.goal: A verified reachable ground point whose direct route crosses the wall and whose detour is visible
trials.stimulus: One game-issued destination, followed only by observation and the verified cancellation if needed
trials.observe: Distinguish route through opening, contact-and-slide, persistent contact, wrong destination and no movement

budgetSemantics: Observation budget is a stop trigger, not a proven bound on latched game motion; actual cancellation must be available.
stopConditions: guest process or VM identity change

classifications.nativeObstacleRoutingObserved: A single destination request led through the accessible opening without custom steering; supports native routing in that scene, does not prove a general navmesh or client-side planner.
classifications.collisionResponseOnly: Movement contacted/slid along the wall without reaching the detour; supports local collision handling, not absence of pathfinding elsewhere.
classifications.negativeInconclusive: No route may be caused by gesture/settings, endpoint mismatch, range, surface, unavailable path data or server behavior; preserve uncertainty.

followOn: Repeat a successful scene before broadening.
Trace destination setter/update callers and collision queries using exact-build REA/static evidence.
If native routing is reusable, wrap that behavior first. New pathfinder remains outside this experiment.
